title: Per-Component Hover and Vertex Spheres
description: Wgpu renderer cursor parity with React: theme-aware custom SVG cursors (selectable, grab, resize, text, etc.) applied to canvas based on hit targets and drag state.
summary: Fixed rectangle marquee live preview for component selection (vertex/edge/face). Root causes: marquee polygon was in global screen coordinates while projected pick points use viewport-local space; rectangle hit-testing used polygon[0] and polygon[1] (adjacent corners) instead of the full marquee bounds. Added marquee_local_polygon() to convert global drag points to pick-rect-local space, fixed marquee_rect_bounds() in kernel_3d_scene to use min/max of all polygon points, and scoped component marquee to active_object_id. Added tests for pick_bounds offset preview. Rebuilt WGPU wasm (also fixed pre-existing AssetPollReset compile errors blocking trunk).
